notes.title: Patch notes: Apr 18, 2024
notes.content:
MISC
[list]
[*]Worlds can now be removed from random selection in Versus mode: fly to a world on the map and press the Y button (or equivalent key)
[*]Added a Hold to Pause option for Versus mode to the controls menu
[*]Ships extracting in Cash Grab now keep their shields
[*]Improved Warpshot collisions with Missiles, Sidewinders and Proximity Mines
[*]Newly unlocked worlds are now immediately added to the random selection list in Versus mode
[*]Fixed score saving in Bounty mode when only using player slots 2 or 3
[*]Fixed Weapon Test scores sometimes not saving properly
[/list]

[h3]If you have problems with this patch, please fill out the [url=https://astroduel2.com/support]Bug Report Form[/url] to let us know what went wrong![/h3]

notes.title: Introducing: Bounty Mode
notes.content:
We’re just under [i]two weeks[/i] from the launch of Astro Duel 2! To celebrate, we're pleased to reveal a [i]BRAND NEW, NEVER BEFORE SEEN [/i] major game mode that will be available immediately at launch. Get ready for [b]Bounty Mode[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42880290/26edb10b83a30bbc1bc09b5ef5a4815f8ff1ad2f.gif[/img]

Bounty Mode is a progression-based mini-campaign built on Astro Duel 2's addicting arena gameplay. Take to the stars and build up your riches and infamy as you play the role of intergalactic mercenary. Whether you're running with a pack of space outlaws with [b]up to three players in co-op mode or flying solo,[/b] there are plenty of jobs available for a hired gun.

Get ready to face savage beasts and their nefarious robot wranglers, fend off relentless invaders, pull off daring heists, and tackle raiders armed to the teeth with jetpacks and rifles. It's an all-out cosmic brawl where every moment is packed with adrenaline-pumping action!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42880290/94c157cbc8f6c324123ff8ed6f991359bb5ad5dd.png[/img]

[b]Weapons Testing in the Abyss[/b]: Ever wanted to play guinea pig with experimental weapons? Dive into dangerous, infested space caves and unleash havoc with technology that is as unpredictable as it is deadly. Your accuracy and reflexes won't be the only things put to the test in this mode: the real challenge will be utilizing your creativity and improvisation skills to wipe out your enemies as efficiently as possible.

[b]Bloodsport in the Skies[/b]: Imagine this: waves of mutant pests infesting highrise buildings, and you? You're the exterminator. But there's a twist - as you mow down the hordes, the rich patrons above cheer for more blood and death. It's survival of the fittest, and in this game, the pests aren't the only ones with claws.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42880290/d10d9aca273e4f600469230cda7c71a79429f6b0.png[/img]

[b]Upgrade and Explore[/b]: The Shadow Market is home to everything an outlaw needs to make it to the top. Everyone starts small, but as your influence grows, so will your fleet, arsenal, and abilities. But you're not just buying at Shadow Market. Your services are also for sale, and business is [i]good.[/i] The more you prove yourself, the more attention you'll gain, bringing with it new jobs, bounties, and challenges. Earn your worth and take on the ever-growing gauntlet of black-market dirty work thrown your way by the salt of the galaxy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42880290/89fd5a46790e97de4285f3b2d67e742c003b1832.gif[/img]

Whether being played as a single-player campaign or as an all-nighter co-op experience, Bounty Mode brings a whole new depth to Astro Duel 2, and we're so happy to say that it will be available for [b]FREE[/b] at launch on March 7th. If you haven't yet, please wishlist the game (and tell your friends to wishlist too!)

While we gear up for launch, come hang with us in the official [url=https://discord.gg/ZzdWpQT3NS]Astro Duel 2 Discord server[/url]! Who knows- maybe we have even more to reveal? 👀🚀

- Wild Rooster
